_comment: Scripted outcome of the outbound Property-Manager verification call, keyed by booking_id. Used by POST /api/v1/calls/property-manager when no live verification report (posted by the Oh-YO Property Verification bot) exists for the booking. Fields: call_status completed|no_answer; booking_honored true|false (only meaningful when completed); deny_reason none|overbooked|maintenance|price_low; resolution confirmed|penalty_warning_accepted|alternate_room|arr_pitch_accepted|compensation_added|not_honored.

601001.notes: PM confirmed the booking on first ask.

601003.notes: No response after configured retry attempts.

601004.notes: PM declared overbooking; backend occupancy check confirmed 100% occupancy.

601005.notes: PM claimed overbooking but backend showed availability; PM accepted after penalty advisory.

601006.notes: Property under maintenance; PM arranged an alternate room for the stay.

601007.notes: Full-building maintenance; no alternate room available.

601008.notes: Booking rate meets 7-day ARR; PM agreed to honor after ARR comparison.

601009.notes: Booking rate below 7-day ARR; PM accepted after complimentary amount was added.

601010.notes: PM refused even after the complimentary amount offer.
